# nah_load_balancer (Data Source)

Reads a NahCloud load_balancer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nah_load_balancer" "app" {
  project = "my-app"
  id      = "LOAD_BALANCER_ID"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Opaque resource ID.
- `project` (String) Project slug.

### Read-Only

- `algorithm` (String) Routing algorithm.
- `health_check_path` (String) Health check path.
- `name` (String) Load balancer name.
- `port` (Number) Listener port.
- `project_id` (String) Opaque owning project ID.
- `protocol` (String) Listener protocol.
- `region` (String) Derived region.
- `status` (String) Status.
- `subnet_id` (String) Opaque subnet ID.
